baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted object at word 1, rooted in ر ب ب, is followed by the intensive imperative at word 2, rooted in ك ب ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship and authority supply the relation, while regarding something as great supplies the commanded act: the addressee must reorder perceived rank around the Lord rather than merely append a praise formula.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the relational center whose rank governs the command.
Regarding something as great supplies the act of consciously and publicly assigning decisive magnitude.

changed_reading.before: State that your Lord is great.
changed_reading.after: Make your Lord the decisive scale by which every competing authority and magnitude is ranked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus noun at word 1 can carry repair, nurture, and completion, while the imperative at word 2 commands magnification.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command can magnify not only sovereign status but the Lord's stage-by-stage work of tending, repairing, and bringing to completion; greatness is recognized through formative care.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make sustained formative care the content being magnified.
Regard for greatness turns that quiet formative care into the object of explicit recognition.

changed_reading.before: Magnify a Lord understood chiefly as ruler.
changed_reading.after: Magnify your Lord by recognizing the greatness of the care that forms, repairs, and completes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rising with resolve and warning to awaken caution turn magnification from an isolated devotional act into the governing scale of a public mission: the warning is undertaken under the Lord's authority and not the messenger's self-importance.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority supply the mission's governing source rather than a status claimed by its human bearer.
Regarding as great makes the Lord's rank the scale carried into the preceding commission.
Resolve and rising toward a task supply the mobilization that magnification directs.
Warning that arouses caution supplies the public action whose authority must remain Lord-centered.

structural_cues: 74:2 immediately precedes the focus as a compact imperative pair, and 74:3 continues the command sequence.
The focus fronts the Lord-object before the fa-linked imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resolved rising, warning, lordship, and greatness branches in adjacent commands; I infer that magnification regulates the posture and authority of warning. A live alternative is that these are simply parallel commands without a governing relation.

changed_reading.before: Magnify your Lord as a separate act after receiving a mission.
changed_reading.after: Rise and warn in a way that makes your Lord, not the messenger, the mission's governing magnitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition joins favor used to burden its recipient with the pursuit of numerical increase. That supplies a rival scale-making practice: enlarging one's own ledger. Magnifying the Lord therefore entails refusing to manufacture personal greatness through gifts and expected returns.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and ownership locate ultimate possession away from the giver's self-authored account.
Assigning greatness becomes the positive scale opposed to making one's own contribution loom large.
Burdening a recipient by rehearsing a favor supplies the self-inflating gift ledger that must be refused.
Abundance and numerical growth supply the sought increase that competes with Lord-centered greatness.

structural_cues: 74:6 remains in the opening second-person command sequence but switches to a prohibition.
The focus's greatness root and 74:6's abundance root create a nearby contrast between two kinds of enlargement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor-as-burden and growth-in-number beside the focus command; I infer a contrast between magnifying the Lord and enlarging one's own moral or material account. A live alternative takes 74:6 only as a discrete rule about recompense.

changed_reading.before: Give verbal or inward greatness to your Lord.
changed_reading.after: Make your Lord great by declining every gift economy that turns your generosity into your own increase and stature.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated Lord-directed construction is paired with restraining the self from panic. Magnification becomes durable allegiance: the scale installed in 74:3 is maintained under pressure in 74:7.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority establish the allegiance declared by the focus.
Regarding the Lord as great installs the scale that endurance preserves.
Repeated lordship and authority make the Lord the explicit beneficiary and reason for endurance.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the temporal durability of magnification.

structural_cues: The construction in 74:7, a fronted phrase naming your Lord followed by a fa-imperative, closely mirrors 74:3.
Both verses belong to the same opening command series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated Lord phrase and self-restraint branch; I infer that patience is magnification extended through time and adversity. A live alternative is that patience is merely another independent duty for the same Lord.

changed_reading.before: Magnification is a moment of proclamation or valuation.
changed_reading.after: Magnification is allegiance kept at full scale by restraining the self from collapse under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponent deliberates, constructs a measure, then turns away and self-magnifies. Repetition of the focus greatness root reveals a directional reversal: either greatness is assigned to the Lord, or the measuring self grows large enough to reject what confronts it.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority provide the rightful pole of scale and submission.
Regarding another as great supplies the outward-directed act commanded in the focus.
The heart's repeated turning over a matter supplies the inward workshop of the rival scale.
Planning by measurement and inspection supplies the act of constructing that rival evaluation.
Self-magnification and refusal to submit invert the focus root from Lord-directed greatness into self-exaltation.

structural_cues: 74:18-23 forms a temporal chain from deliberation and measurement to retreat and self-magnification.
The same ك ب ر root occurs in the focus imperative and in the opponent's later reflexive posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberation, evaluative planning, and self-magnification in one narrative chain; I infer that 74:3 preempts a contest over who controls scale. A live alternative is that the later root repetition marks pride generally without answering the focus command point for point.

changed_reading.before: Magnify the Lord as a positive confession.
changed_reading.after: Relinquish the self's power to manufacture scale: magnifying the Lord is the exact reversal of thinking, measuring, and then magnifying oneself against the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord reappears with mutually supporting hosts whose extent no creature knows. Magnification becomes epistemic restraint before an authority whose operative resources exceed the observer's count and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority establish the commander whose magnitude is in view.
Regarding as great becomes acknowledgment that human measurement does not exhaust the Lord's command.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic boundary because the verse restricts who possesses this knowledge.
A mutually supporting host supplies organized power whose extent remains undisclosed.
The repeated Lord relation explicitly owns and commands the unknowable hosts.

structural_cues: 74:31 explicitly joins knowing, hosts, and your Lord in one clause.
The possessive form your Lord repeats the focus relation at a remote structural hinge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restricted disclosure, a supporting host, and repeated lordship; I infer that unknowability is a reason to resist reducing greatness to what can be counted. A live alternative is that the clause only blocks speculation about the specific hosts.

changed_reading.before: Estimate the Lord as greater than known powers.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledge a command whose organized reach exceeds your inventory; magnification includes refusing to make human count the ceiling of power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close first exposes absent fear of the Hereafter, then names God as fit for protective wariness and fit for forgiveness. This qualifies greatness: the Lord is not magnified as raw terror but as the proper center of guarded accountability and preserving cover.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify the one whose greatness orders accountability.
Regarding as great supplies the affective and evaluative reorientation clarified by the closing pair.
Dread that anticipates harm is explicitly absent, exposing the affective mis-scaling that magnification corrects.
Fitness and worthiness supply an explicit criterion for both protective wariness and forgiveness.
Warding off harm by protection turns awe into guarded conduct rather than undirected panic.
Covering sin and preserving its bearer from the effect place mercy inside, not outside, the Lord's greatness.

structural_cues: 74:53 negates fear of the Hereafter, while 74:56 closes the surah with repeated worthiness language.
The paired close holds protective wariness and forgiveness under the same divine subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent expected-harm fear, explicit worthiness, protective guarding, and preserving cover; I infer that these specify the affective shape of magnification. A live alternative is that the close lists independent divine attributes without revising the earlier imperative.

changed_reading.before: Magnify the Lord chiefly as overwhelming authority.
changed_reading.after: Recognize the Lord as great enough to be rightly guarded toward and great enough to cover: awe and forgiveness jointly define the scale.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the one-faced drum is a lexical fringe of ك ب ر rather than the ordinary sense of the focus verb. It remains anchored in the focus branch and is activated by the later struck-sound branch at 74:8; downstream prose should present it only as a sonic image for audible proclamation, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 of the focus is rooted in ك ب ر, whose packet inventory includes a one-faced drum image.

activation_trace.role: The one-faced drum supplies a branch-distant image of magnification made percussively public.
Rapid struck sound supplies the later acoustic event that activates the focus root's drum image.

changed_reading.before: Magnification is an inward estimate or an unspecified utterance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, let magnification sound out as a public struck proclamation whose later acoustic counterpart reaches the whole scene.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping for the focus noun and a fringe high-day branch of ك ب ر. It remains traceable to both focus roots and to the dawn-unveiling sequence at 74:34-35; render it as an imagistic manifestation of perceived scale, not as a claim that the Lord literally increases or changes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus mapping permits an increase-and-rising image for word 1, while word 2 has a high-part-of-day branch.

activation_trace.role: Increase and rising supply a non-dominant vertical image for the Lord's scale becoming manifest.
The high part of day links magnification to a branch-distant image of ascending daylight.
Morning and the first daylight supply the temporal onset of manifested scale.
The bright unveiling of light supplies the transition from hidden greatness to visible effect.
Greatness opposed to smallness confirms scale as the explicit destination of the dawn image.

changed_reading.before: Assign the Lord a greater rank conceptually.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, make the Lord's surpassing scale emerge into perception as morning light rises and unveils the day.

strongest_changes: The adjacent commission turns magnification into the governing posture of warning rather than a detached praise act.
The favor-and-increase prohibition opposes Lord-centered greatness to enlarging one's own ledger.
The later self-magnifier reverses the focus root and exposes a contest over who controls scale.
The closing pair of protective wariness and forgiveness qualifies greatness as accountable and preserving, not merely terrifying.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots become a scale-making hinge for the whole surah: authority, care, mission, endurance, anti-accumulation, epistemic limit, and the reversal into self-exaltation remain distinct but mutually illuminating readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Object fronting strongly marks emphasis, but the degree of exclusivity assigned to it remains a reader inference.
The exact relation of the 74:6 prohibition to self-inflation admits more than one syntactic reading.
The non-dominant rising map and the drum and high-day branches are licensed packet images but remain deliberately exploratory rather than lexical glosses.
The closing worthiness pair may specify the focus's greatness or may function as an independent conclusion.
